rules.applicability: All Website/Software/Services users; covers trading alone or in concert, including connected accounts and accounts held with different Users
rules.notes: Prohibited: trades or combinations of trades, alone or in concert with others (including connected accounts or accounts of different Users), whose purpose is to manipulate, abuse or give any User an unfair advantage. Consequence per Terms: transactions may be removed/not counted, or access cancelled and account terminated without compensation or refund. Complements SH081–SH086 (hedging) and SH079 (copiers permitted). Terms Last Modified 2025-03-20.
rules.source_locator: Terms of Use, 'Prohibited Uses', bullet 'Performing, alone or in concert with any other persons, including connected accounts, or accounts held with different Users, trades ... to manipulate, abuse, or give any User an unfair advantage'

rules.applicability: Coordinated activity with others, including between unconnected accounts and third parties
rules.notes: Prohibited: acting in concert with others (incl. between unconnected accounts and third parties) with the same strategy, the opposite strategy or other activity meant to pool or hedge the risk of the aggregate accounts. The Terms do not define 'same trading strategy'; how this interacts with the permitted trade copiers (SH079) across one's own accounts is not stated. Terms Last Modified 2025-03-20.
rules.source_locator: Terms of Use, 'Prohibited Uses', bullet 'In concert with others, including between unconnected accounts and third parties, performing the same trading strategy, opposite strategy, or other activity mean to pool or hedge risk of the aggregate, unconnected accounts'

rules.notes: Prohibited: trading on behalf of others, including sharing any incentives as part of a business arrangement. Related: SH122 account_access_sharing (prohibited). Terms Last Modified 2025-03-20.
rules.source_locator: Terms of Use, 'Prohibited Uses', bullet 'Trading on behalf of others including but not limited to sharing any incentives as part of any business arrangement'

rules.applicability: Website user account (username/password, in the account-security section), 'unless expressly authorized'. Not the count of evaluation/funded trading accounts (support limits: SH056–SH059).
rules.notes: One Website account per person unless expressly authorized; violation may result in termination of all associated accounts and forfeiture of funds or profits. The Terms do not define 'account' further; read in context of the username/password paragraph. Related: SH112 profile_limit 1. Terms Last Modified 2025-03-20.
rules.source_locator: Terms of Use, 'Accessing the Website and Account Security': 'Unless expressly authorized, you are restricted to one account.'

rules.applicability: Between products or with any other user
rules.notes: Prohibited: transferring or combining an account's performance, service parameters, data or other information between products or with any other user. Terms Last Modified 2025-03-20.
rules.source_locator: Terms of Use, 'Accessing the Website and Account Security': 'You may not transfer or combine your account's performance, service parameters, data, or any other information between products or with any other user.'

rules.applicability: Symbol 1OZ (1-Ounce Gold futures); Lucid approved-products table; stage distinction not stated
rules.notes: The 1-Ounce Gold futures contract (symbol 1OZ) is not on Lucid's Approved Products and Commissions list; the only gold products listed are GC (2.30 per side, COMEX) and MGC (0.80 per side, COMEX). The page does not say in words that unlisted products are prohibited, nor whether platforms block them; tradability of 1OZ therefore not stated beyond 'not listed'. Exchange of 1OZ not stated on the Lucid page (column left blank). Related: SH104 (GC), SH105 (MGC).
rules.source_locator: Approved Products and Commissions, full symbol table (35 rows): gold rows are GC 'Gold Futures' and MGC 'Micro Gold Futures' only; no 1OZ row

source_records.title: LucidFlex Customization
source_records.short_quote: No Daily Loss Limit is applied during either the evaluation or funded phase
source_records.notes: DLL 選項、兩階段適用、選定後不可更改。

source_records.title: LucidFlex Evaluation Account
source_records.short_quote: One-time fee, no monthly rebilling, take as long as you need to pass
source_records.notes: 50K 目標、MLL、合約數、activation 費及最快兩日路徑。

source_records.title: LucidFlex Funded Account
source_records.short_quote: There is no Consistency Percentage on LucidFlex funded accounts
source_records.notes: Funded 為模擬帳戶，有 scaling；無 consistency。

source_records.title: LucidFlex Payouts
source_records.short_quote: 50% of their account balance
source_records.notes: 表格另寫 50% of Profit。分母定義不一致，cycle profit 計算起點亦未完整交代。

source_records.title: LucidFlex Consistency Percentage
source_records.short_quote: Largest Single Day Profit / Account Profit = Consistency Percentage
source_records.notes: 標準為不超過 50%。另有 cushion 範例，但無可普遍套用公式。

source_records.title: LucidFlex Scaling Plan
source_records.short_quote: The scaling plan updates at the end of each session
source_records.notes: 50K funded 顯示 0–999、1000–1999、2000–2999 三檔；小數、負數與更高餘額分檔未明示。

source_records.title: LucidFlex Drawdown
source_records.short_quote: Once you request a payout from LucidFlex, your MLL automatically adjusts to the Locked MLL Balance
source_records.notes: EOD trailing、50K MLL 2000、trail 52100、floor 50100。

source_records.title: LucidFlex Live (Legacy)
source_records.short_quote: This is for accounts purchased/reset on 2/27/26 and prior.
source_records.notes: 只作舊 cohort 分界參照，不能將六次 payout 套入當日新購。

source_records.title: New Live Structure
source_records.short_quote: All live transitions occur at the discretion of the Lucid risk team.
source_records.notes: 頁面顯示 Updated today。Payout 5 是上限；可以提前接受 live review。未列新制生效 cohort。

source_records.title: Allowed Trading Times
source_records.short_quote: All positions must be closed by 4:45 PM EST, Monday through Friday
source_records.notes: 原文使用 EST；未明示全年固定 UTC−5 抑或 Eastern DST。

source_records.title: Inactivity Policy
source_records.short_quote: within 30 calendar days
source_records.notes: 需要有交易產生至少 1 美元淨盈利或虧損；具體時鐘起點、邊界及淨額期間未完整定義。

source_records.title: Maximum Number of Accounts
source_records.short_quote: Up to 5 active funded accounts per household or family.
source_records.notes: 合計 evaluation + funded 上限 10；funded 跨 plan 合計 5。

source_records.title: Payout Methods
source_records.short_quote: Available for both U.S. and international traders
source_records.notes: WorkMarket、Plaid、國際 crypto；本文無明示 payout fee。

source_records.title: Approved Products and Commissions
source_records.short_quote: Commission (Per Side)
source_records.notes: 佣金按每邊、每合約；本試行版僅列 ES/MES/NQ/MNQ/MGC，完整產品表見連結。

source_records.title: Prohibited: Microscalping
source_records.short_quote: More than 50% of your profits are generated from trades held for 5 seconds or less
source_records.notes: 超出門檻觸發 review，並非直接等同自動 hard breach。

source_records.title: Prohibited: Hedging
source_records.short_quote: Hedging between different firms or funded platforms
source_records.notes: 跨帳戶、跨用戶及跨 firm 對沖受禁；同帳戶部分 mini/micro 及不同合約例外見原文。

source_records.title: Prohibited: High Frequency Trading
source_records.short_quote: You will receive a written warning
source_records.notes: 首次警告，重複可扣除盈利、關閉帳戶並永久限制服務；無數值頻率門檻。

source_records.title: Other Trading Activities
source_records.short_quote: Automated trading systems and trade copiers are permitted
source_records.notes: Flex 可 news trading、DCA、genuine scalping、flipping；仍須符合其他規則。

source_records.title: Trade with Integrity
source_records.short_quote: Taking advantage of system errors or update delays
source_records.notes: 不可利用模擬成交、價格差錯或系統延遲。

source_records.title: Simulated Account Fees
source_records.short_quote: A reset returns the account to its original starting conditions
source_records.notes: 一般 reset 說明；費用段落只點名 Pro/Direct，不作 Flex 費用直接證据。

source_records.title: Lucid Trading homepage
source_records.short_quote: No monthly subscription or funded account activation fees
source_records.notes: Cloud browser 13:23–13:24 UTC 核實 Flex > 50K > DLL OFF：參考 $146、coupon $105.20、reset $105。Registration security verification 阻擋 checkout。 Public configurator inspected for all36 configurations. Dollar symbol only; couponVAULT not tested at checkout.

source_records.title: Refund & Liability Policy
source_records.short_quote: strict no refund policy for accounts that have been traded
source_records.notes: 未交易帳戶只可能酌情退款；個別技術問題及 slippage 並不保證補償。

source_records.title: Terms of Use
source_records.short_quote: Prices and availability of products are subject to change without notice.
source_records.notes: 通用條款有 subscription 文字，與 Flex 一次性收費頁不能混用；此處僅記錄需核對特定訂單/合約。

source_records.title: Lucid Trading Supported Platforms
source_records.short_quote: All listed platforms work with all Lucid account types.
source_records.notes: CQG 及 Rithmic 平台選擇；個別軟件/數據費是否另計未列。
